title: Bandwidth Control limits: rules, classes, domains

prose.text: Several counts matter for Bandwidth Control. {{rules-125}} {{rules-lower-than-other-policies}} A per-department or per-application rule design therefore reaches the cap sooner.

prose.label: Classes.
prose.text: {{custom-classes-245}} {{predefined-8}} {{name-255}} How the eight predefined classes map to the tabs and API types is in [[zia.bandwidth-control.api-surface]].
Whether any of these caps is enforced by the API is open {{gap:caps-api-enforced}}, and how the pools nest is open {{gap:domain-pool-relationship}}.

checks.do: Whether the policy's rule count is near the cap of 125 rules.
Whether any class carries custom domains, counting against the cap of 8 classes that may use the Domains field.
Whether domains from URL categories are being counted toward the same 25,000-domain cap.

rules-125.statement: An organization can have 125 Bandwidth Control policy rules.

quotes: Bandwidth Control Policy Rules per Organization | 125 rules

custom-classes-245.statement: An organization can have up to 245 custom bandwidth classes.

quotes: You can add up to 245 custom bandwidth classes.

domain-classes-8.statement: At most 8 bandwidth classes can have custom domains. This is a cap on the number of classes that use the Domains field, not on domains.
domain-classes-8.conditions: Stated under the Cloud Applications tab; the Help does not say how the cap applies to the other three tabs.

quotes: You can have up to 8 bandwidth classes with custom domains.
You can add up to 25,000 domains across all bandwidth classes (including URL categories).
You can add domains for up to 8 individual bandwidth classes.

domains-25000.statement: Up to 25,000 domains can be added across all bandwidth classes, including those from URL categories.
domains-25000.conditions: Stated under the Cloud Applications tab.

quotes: You can add up to 25,000 domains across all bandwidth classes (including URL categories).

predefined-8.statement: The Ranges and Limitations page lists 8 predefined bandwidth classes.

name-255.statement: A bandwidth class name can be up to 255 characters.

page-500.statement: The class Domains list shows up to 500 items per page.

quotes: For item lists, you can view up to 500 items on a page
evidence.after: Domains: Enter the URLs that you want to include in the bandwidth class and click Add Items.

counts-toward-custom-urls.statement: Bandwidth Class Domains are among the entries counted in the Custom URLs/TLDs limit (25K by default, extendable by subscription); duplicates are counted once.

quotes: Bandwidth Class Domains Duplicate URLs/TLDs are counted once.
The default limit for custom URLs/TLDs is 25K.
Contact your Zscaler Account team to subscribe to up to an additional 50K custom URLs/TLDs.

rules-lower-than-other-policies.statement: The Ranges and Limitations table lists 125 Bandwidth Control rules per organization, against 1,000 for URL Filtering and 1,024 for all other policy rules such as DLP and IPS Control.

quotes: | Bandwidth Control Policy Rules per Organization | 125 rules |
| All Other Policy Rules (i.e., DLP Policy, Inline Web DLP Policy, IPS Control Policy, etc.) | 1,024 rules |

caps-api-enforced.title: Whether the rule, class and domain caps are enforced by the API
caps-api-enforced.detail: The caps come from console Help. No captured source shows whether the API rejects writes beyond them or only the console does.
caps-api-enforced.blocks: deciding whether automation needs its own guard before hitting a cap

domain-pool-relationship.title: Class domain cap versus the custom URL pool
domain-pool-relationship.detail: Class domains count toward the Custom URLs/TLDs limit, yet Help separately gives 25,000 domains across all classes, and the About Bandwidth Classes article gives 75,000 custom URLs and 64 custom categories. How the 25,000 class cap sits inside the 25K-plus-subscription pool is not stated.
